args.Description: Fix article card hover animation
args.Instruction: Change transition-colors to transition-all so transform and box-shadow animate smoothly on hover
args.ReplacementContent:
<template x-for="(article, articleIndex) in displayedArticles" :key="articleKey(article, articleIndex)">
                    <div class="article-card mb-4 md:mb-5 relative overflow-hidden bg-[#111827] rounded-2xl cursor-pointer group border border-white/5 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg" :class="[
                            (isMobile && mobileActiveCard === article.link) ? 'ring-2 ring-emerald-500' : '',
                            readStates.includes(article.link) ? 'opacity-60' : ''
                        ]" @click="handleCardClick(article, $event)">
args.TargetContent:
<template x-for="(article, articleIndex) in displayedArticles" :key="articleKey(article, articleIndex)">
                    <div class="article-card mb-4 md:mb-5 relative overflow-hidden bg-[#111827] rounded-2xl cursor-pointer group border border-white/5 hover:border-white/20 transition-colors duration-200 shadow-lg" :class="[
                            (isMobile && mobileActiveCard === article.link) ? 'ring-2 ring-emerald-500' : '',
                            readStates.includes(article.link) ? 'opacity-60' : ''
                        ]" @click="handleCardClick(article, $event)">

args.Description: Fix article overlay modal dynamic theme background
args.Instruction: Update the article overlay modal header and panel backgrounds to use dynamic theme classes instead of hardcoded hex values, ensuring it matches the liquid glass design.
args.ReplacementContent:
x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0 scale-100"
             x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-8 md:translate-y-4 scale-95"

             :class="theme === 'glass-light' ? 'bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/40 shadow-emerald-900/10' : (theme === 'glass-dark' ? 'bg-[#0f172a]/80 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/10' : 'bg-[#111827]')" 
             @click.stop @touchstart.stop>
            
            <!-- Header -->
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 flex-shrink-0" :class="theme === 'glass-light' ? 'border-b border-gray-200/50 bg-white/40' : (theme === 'glass-dark' ? 'border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0B101E]/40' : 'border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0B101E]')">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">

                    </button>
